product.title: Acadia Full Day Private Tour and Hike

description.text: Spend 6–8 hours exploring Acadia National Park with a naturalist guide on a private itinerary: hiking toward Bubble Rock, walking the Ocean Path to Thunder Hole, stopping at Jordan Pond, and driving up to the summit of Cadillac Mountain. The private format lets your group tailor hike difficulty and pacing. Stops include Bubble Rock, Ocean Path, Thunder Hole, Jordan Pond, Cadillac Mountain. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
